FOR THESE REASONS, THE COURT, UNANIMOUSLY,

Declares the application admissible;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found the application met admissibility criteria under Article 35 and was neither manifestly ill-founded nor inadmissible on other grounds.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 8 of the Convention

anchor.surface_text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 8 of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found the search of the applicant's house was not conducted in accordance with the law due to absence of two attesting witnesses as required by domestic law, violating Article 8.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 6 § 1 of the Convention

anchor.surface_text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 6 § 1 of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court held that the use of unlawfully obtained evidence without proper procedural safeguards rendered the criminal proceedings unfair, violating Article 6 § 1.

holdings.text: Holds that there is no need to examine the complaint under Article 6 §§ 1 and 3 (d) of the Convention

anchor.surface_text: Holds that there is no need to examine the complaint under Article 6 §§ 1 and 3 (d) of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: Given the violation found under Article 6 § 1, the Court found it unnecessary to examine the related complaint under Article 6 §§ 1 and 3 (d).

holdings.text: Holds that the respondent State is to pay the applicant, within three months from the date on which the judgment becomes final in accordance with Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the following amounts: EUR 10,000 plus any tax for non-pecuniary damage; EUR 229 plus any tax for costs and expenses; and interest thereafter
holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court awarded just satisfaction for non-pecuniary damage and costs, rejecting pecuniary damage claims due to lack of substantiation, and ordered default interest.

holdings.text: Dismisses the remainder of the applicant’s claim for just satisfaction

anchor.surface_text: Dismisses, the remainder of the applicant’s claim for just satisfaction.

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court rejected the applicant's pecuniary damage claim for lack of substantiation and dismissed other claims for just satisfaction.

outcome.relief_summary: The Court found violations of Articles 8 and 6 § 1 and awarded the applicant EUR 10,000 for non-pecuniary damage and EUR 229 for costs and expenses; pecuniary damage claim was dismissed; remainder of just satisfaction claim dismissed.
directions: Respondent State to pay awarded amounts within three months from final judgment date.
Simple interest payable on awarded amounts from expiry of three months until settlement.
